# Third-party source included in the repository

## ST67W6X Network Driver

`ST67W6X_Network_Driver` is the small source subset used directly by the
Non-Secure STM32CubeIDE project. It was copied from STMicroelectronics
X-CUBE-ST67W61 V1.3.0 (10 April 2026).

Included directories:

- `Api`
- `Core`
- `Driver/W61_at`
- `Driver/W61_bus`
- `Utils/Misc`

The complete downloaded expansion package, ZIP archive, examples, binaries,
and documentation are intentionally not part of Git. A local copy is kept
under `.local-dependencies/sdk/x-cube-st67w61` and ignored by `.gitignore`.

See `ST67W6X_Network_Driver/LICENSE.txt` and
`ST67W6X_Network_Driver/Package_license.html` for the applicable terms.
